summary: Tested FocusEdge (Class 6-8) end to end, backend and frontend. Backend: the new test file /app/backend/tests/test_focusedge.py has 13 tests and all 13 pass. They cover demo users; the existing fe-aarav report (10 areas D1-D10, overall equals the mean, 3 priorities, a 5-activity fe-* plan starting with fe-wake, priority pages with theory and 2 activities each, a narrative with no clinical words); POST /assessments/start (40 items, one per sub-theme, ids like D1.1-03, never two from the same segment in a row); wrong item set gives 422 mentioning 40; wellness/today and reads (20 FE reads, FE area names); games/enabled (the 9 FE ids, and [sudoku, memory, zerokata] for EquiMind); media scoping (16 FocusEdge items for FE students, 14 general items for EquiMind, MindEdge and MindMellow students, all for admin); admin media add and delete with programme=focusedge, and invalid programme gives 422; admin items (300 items, 40 sub-themes), activities, stats, product doc (300 ids); counsellors mm-neha and me-rahul see the 3 FE students; cou-kavya does not. I also submitted one full check-in for fe-vihaan, which you allowed: it returned 200 in about 5s with a Claude narrative and no clinical words, the plan [fe-wake, fe-pomo, fe-phone, fe-phonebed, fe-2min], and resubmitting gave 400. Frontend (Playwright): the /focusedge landing (indigo brand, 4 product tabs, 40/10 stats, 10 area cards, 3 swatches); login order is fe-aarav, fe-meher, fe-vihaan, mm-neha, me-rahul, adm-platform. On the fe-aarav dashboard the DailyLog popup shows the 5 FE plan questions, including 'Did your phone stay in another room while you studied today?'. Activity of the Day shows 5-4-3-2-1 Calm Senses and Echo Pattern, and the game opens and plays. Toolkit shows the 9 FE brain games, FE Calm Shorts, FE Audiobooks and 20 FE reads. The report has every requested element (cover eyebrow, 40 items, 3 Needs care first areas, 10-axis radar, area-score-D1..D10, What's Happening, fe_d* art, Week 1 Notice / Week 2 Start small, 4 help tiers, 3 scripts, Childline 1098, Eye check row, FE About copy, Week 1 progress page). Download PDF works (FocusEdge-Report-Aarav-Sharma.pdf, 4.9MB). me-rahul and mm-neha see Aarav, Meher and Vihaan under All students and Needs attention, and the Meher report opens with FocusEdge branding. Admin: the FocusEdge switch, overview stats and bar chart, question bank ('300 of 300 items ... 40 per check-in'), activities, the Media library switch and product doc all render. Regression: the EquiMind admin and student dashboards (own games and media) and the MindEdge landing keep their own colours. Problems found: FE videos never reach students, plus a few UX and copy issues.

minor.issue: MediaIn.programme defaults to 'all'. Any client that updates without sending programme silently moves a FocusEdge item into the general library. The current MediaManager does send it, so this is a latent risk only.
test_mindedge.py and test_iter20_programme_scope.py hardcode report ids from the old DB, so 7 of their tests fail with 404 on the fresh DB. This is expected test drift, not an app bug.

ui_bugs.issue: No Videos section anywhere for students. StudentHome only renders <Audiobooks>; the AudioVideo/Videos ListCard is unused since an earlier checkpoint. The 7 FocusEdge videos (e.g. 'The Power of 'Yet'', 'Growth Mindset — Your Brain Can Grow', 'Pomo-25 timer') can only be reached by admins. The review request expects students to see FE Videos.
'Yes, I did' always has a solid primary fill, even before an answer or after 'Not this time' is picked. The selected state is ambiguous, and Next stays disabled although Yes looks selected.

design_issues.screen: Counsellor portal + report viewed by counsellor
issues: mm-neha's header shows the MindMellow brand and me-rahul's shows MindEdge, even after signing in from /focusedge/login. The FE report body has FocusEdge branding but the header and accent stay MindMellow, so the brands are mixed.
The product tab bar overflows and the active FocusEdge tab is off-screen; it should scroll the active tab into view. The palette swatches are hidden on mobile.
Journey phases still use the stress-product names (e.g. 'Phase 3: Connecting, Engaging & Enjoying', 'Finding Calm'). Acceptable since the dashboard is meant to be shared, but consider FE wording.

The subtitle says 'Student stress & wellbeing platform ... measures focus ... not stress'. The overview says 'non-diagnostic stress check-in ... not stress' and 'three areas under most pressure'. Both contradict themselves. Section heading 'Games library (26 games)' while FE students get 9.

action_items: Render a Videos list for students (at least FocusEdge) on Home and Toolkit, e.g. bring back AudioVideo or add <Videos>; the 7 FE videos are unreachable today
Fix the FocusEdge product-doc copy: remove 'stress' wording in the subtitle and overview, and clarify the games count
Optional: show the selected state on the DailyLog yes/no buttons
Optional: when a counsellor views a FocusEdge report, use FocusEdge branding in the header too
Optional: make programme required (or keep the existing value) on PUT /api/admin/media
Optional: auto-scroll the active product tab into view on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _media_doc applies the default programme 'all' on update, so editing without the field would move an item to the wrong library
MediaSections.AudioVideo is dead code; the Videos kind is admin-only in practice
content_fe.py is 556 lines and server.py 450, both under the 700-line limit
Narrative safety: narrative.py filters adhd/disorder/diagnos and the live LLM output was clean

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows work; FE Videos not shown to students)
